15.3 Non-replaced elements

15.3.3 Flow content

The following elements are expected to be block-level boxes:

@namespace "http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml";

div { display: block; }

pre {
  display: block;
  white-space: pre;
  margin: 1em 0;
}

The following rules are also expected to apply, as presentational hints:

@namespace "http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml";

pre[wrap] { white-space: pre-wrap; }
table[align=left i] { float: left; }
@namespace "http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml";

dialog { position: absolute; color: black; }
dialog:modal { position: fixed; }

In quirks mode, the following rules are also expected to apply:

@namespace "http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml";

form { display: block; }

15.3.6 Sections and headings

Headings are blocks.

@namespace "http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml";

:heading { display: block; }

15.3.11 The details element

Shadow tree rules.

:host summary { display: list-item; }

15.7 Interactive media

@namespace "http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml";

span { display: inline; }
